data.name: Pool Live Tour Max
data.detailed_description:
Pool Live Tour Max is a competitive and casual 3D billiards experience designed for both new players and pool veterans. The game features realistic physics, smooth controls, and fast-paced online matches where every shot counts.

Play 1v1 duels, climb ranked leaderboards, and unlock new cues, tables, and visual customizations as you progress. Each match is turn-based and skill based, with precise aiming and shot power mechanics that reward accuracy and strategy.

Pool Live Tour Max includes:

Gameplay Features

Realistic 3D physics that simulate accurate ball movement, spin, and collisions

Online Multiplayer  challenge players from around the world in real-time

1v1 Matches & Friendly Games  compete for coins or play for fun

Skill based aiming system with aim guides and adjustable shot power

Intuitive controls optimized for mouse and keyboard

Fast paced rounds designed for competitive players and casual fans

Ranked progression  win matches to climb divisions and earn seasonal rewards

Progression & Rewards

Earn coins and chips through matches, missions

Unlock cues, cue skins, tables, avatars, and visual effects

Improve your stats with cues that offer different accuracy, spin, and power bonuses

Customization

Choose from a wide range of cues, table designs, and player avatars

Cosmetic items allow players to personalize their style

Additional Features

Matchmaking based on skill rating

Regular content updates

Pool Live Tour Max brings the classic pool hall competition to a modern online platform easy to learn, fun to play, but deep enough for serious players who want to master every shot.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / GTX 950 / AMD RX 460 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
